Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring employers to post notices of repetitive motion injuries.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repetitive motion injury notices; and adding anew section to chapter 49.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 49.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each employer shall post and keep posted a notice, which form shallbe furnished by the department, containing information about thehistory of repetitive motion injuries claimed by other employees duringtheir course of employment with the current employer. In addition, thenotice shall also contain specific health and safety standards, if any,recommended by the employer or the department to avoid prospectiverepetitive motion injuries. Such notice shall contain the number ofrepetitive motion injuries occurring during the prior calendar year,the body part or parts affected by the injury, and whether the employeeor employees received workers' compensation benefits as a result of theinjury from the department or the employer, if selfinsured. Suchnotice shall be posted by the employer at each business establishmentwhere there are employees and in a conspicuous place or places where p. 1 SB 6582notices to employees are customarily posted. Each employer shall take steps to assure that such notices are not altered, defaced, or coveredby other material.
